classes.name: ActionApprovalLifecycleModule
classes.description: Sekai-owned deep module that loads pending governed action approvals, re-resolves live policy and resource limits, orders held-effect preparation and execution, meters committed effects, resolves competing parked work, and commits terminal approval decisions.

classes.name: SekaiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that authenticates and authorizes approval callers, maps protocol values and errors, and supplies marking, purpose, effect-execution, and receipt-projection adapters to Sekai lifecycle modules.

classes.name: GovernedActionApproval
classes.description: Durable pending or terminal decision record binding the proposing actor, exact action parameters, policy scope, risk class, target, work unit, and deciding principal.

relations.name: delegates_action_approval_lifecycle_to
relations.description: The gRPC transport delegates approval state, live policy and limit checks, held-effect ordering, metering, competing parked-work resolution, and terminal transitions to the action approval lifecycle module.

relations.name: resolves_governed_action_approval
relations.description: The action approval lifecycle module resolves a pending governed action approval to an approved or denied terminal state while preserving execution and audit ordering.
